name: web-lime-black-white-ai-learning-bento-hero
title: AI Learning Bento Hero in Lime
whatItIs: A white landing hero with a huge thin uppercase headline 'Revolutionize learning with AI-driven education' and a bento of tiles: a black welcome card with an asterisk, a circular text badge, a greyscale brain image, two stat tiles and a large lime 'Flexible' feature tile.
whatItMeans: Thin oversized type with a tight mix of black, grey and lime tiles feels editorial and modern, and the bento organises many ideas cleanly.
techniques: Wide thin uppercase headline with an outlined pill inside the sentence
Bento tiles in black, grey and lime
Circular rotating text badge as a decorative detail
Greyscale image tile against the lime tile
Small tag pills and an arrow icon for the CTA
bestFor: Product pages with multiple key messages

vocabulary.definition: A rounded outlined word inside a headline.
A round graphic with text wrapped around its edge.
A bento tile dedicated to one key benefit.
